declarations.title: Selected Azure DevOps source and pipeline literals have no detected secrets
declarations.remediation: Remove exposed literals from the selected source or nonsecret pipeline variables and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Use supported secret references or workload identities.
declarations.scope: Explicit selected files at immutable commits and selected pipeline definition revisions only; no template expansion, protected values, credential validation or whole-project coverage.

fixture_origin: Independent native HTTP -> actual azure.collect -> unchanged public evaluate_snapshot with test-local candidate/hook overlay. Pure item/index arguments observed using sys.setprofile at inspect.unwrap(evaluate).__code__; no CASES used as native input. No production registration.
root_integration_required: Explicit named check only + content_secret_scans; default optional inventory exclusion.
Server typed selector validation, DevOps credential help/intake and cleanup; no ARM-token substitution.
azure.collect exact collect hook and final_snapshot union-redaction/metadata handoff.
Canonical registration, finding type Secrets, existing Secrets UI group, descriptions/remediation; no numbered mappings.
